media.note: Minimum starting opacity for dark panels; validate on actual moving content. Stronger transport gradient and opaque fallback may be required.

provenance: Logo values sampled from opaque pixels of PigLogo.png. Light roles and dark neutrals/status colours already exist in web CSS. Dark accent and onAccent are sampled logo colours. No new base hex values; opacity composites are derived. Palette assignments approved by user on 2 October 2026.

alignment.rule: Align optical anchor with intended visual centre; preserve aspect ratio.
alignment.productIcons: Product icons are centred on their measured optical centre and normalised to a shared optical size; do not apply the original pig anchor to these different silhouettes.

lockups.unit: C = wordmark cap height (top of P to baseline)
lockups.gap: 0.5C from visible pig edge to first letter
lockups.stackedGap: 0.55C from visible pig bottom to cap top
lockups.verticalAlignment: Pig ink centre on the cap-height centre; descenders ignored
lockups.centring: Centre visible ink, never file or crop boxes; exported files carry equal clear space so centring the file centres the logo
lockups.opticalSize: 0.5 x ink height + 0.5 x (square root of ink area / 0.93), so sparse and wide silhouettes match compact ones

halo.use: Default. App icons, icon backgrounds, welcome, Top Shelf and splash surfaces; centred on the pig optical centre.

splashMotion.scope: splash and launch surfaces only, while already visible; never adds delay

cornerBloom.use: In-app canvas backgrounds: a quiet rose bloom from the top leading corner only (top left in left-to-right layouts), in both appearances. Opaque cards, bars and controls sit above it.

radiatingLight.constraints: Decorative only: never behind forms or reading content, never a focus, selection or progress signal. Honour reduced motion (static halo) and reduced transparency (solid canvas).
radiatingLight.excluded: Rays, removed from the system on 7 October 2026.

pigtv.name: PigTV
pigtv.scope: Existing television app; retained while naming is undecided.

pig-video.name: PigVideo
pig-video.scope: Live TV, movies and TV shows.

identity.default: Distinct fused-pig product icons with established Arial Rounded MT Bold wordmarks.
identity.options: Earlier badge, frame and crop studies are historical; the refined fused set is the base identity.
identity.naming: Pig + a short descriptive noun for new products. PigTV is a retained legacy spelling.
identity.font: ArialRoundedMTBold; distribute outlined wordmarks, not the font.
identity.approval: User approved the outlined four-icon original-nose preview as final on 6 October 2026. Use the exact approved raster source; no redraws. Optical lockup and icon placement approved 7 October 2026. PigDomain (bucket pig), PigBoard (wall board), halo icons, splash motion and top-left corner bloom approved as final 7 October 2026.
identity.nose: Every pig uses the canonical nose (sources/approved/pig-nose.svg, traced from the approved PigTV artwork). Translate only; never resize, redraw or restyle it.

appleTV.wideIdentity: Product icon to the left of the existing rounded application wordmark.
appleTV.launcher: Supplied wide icon + name image stack, with icon-only alternative.
appleTV.topShelf: 1920x720 and 2320x720, with 2x exports; keep content-led dynamic shelves in app projects.
